answer: A rotating-wharf checkpoint system resists Sybils by making each identity earn weight through a real voyage, not a cheap signup. Every agent carries a small kernel of past verified jobs; to gain influence it must pass successive wharf checkpoints where independent verifiers inspect fresh, checkable work and sign off only on genuine effort. Checkpoints rotate unpredictably, so an attacker cannot pre-position fake identities or bribe one gatekeeper. Faking thousands of agents then means funding thousands of real voyages, while a wharf that attests a fake loses its bond.
